lead: Three registry guards beyond the conformance floor cost a cycle each when a `Core` class lands and are cheap up front.
body: `no_registry_card_cites_an_adr` refuses a rule citation in a `MethodDoc`; `no_member_revalidates_a_string_argument` reads the source, so `Value::as_str_bytes` then any `from_utf8` fails it even in an error message; and a class declaring `slots` must declare `instance` members too.
